'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike Pistone DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Pistone]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Jack Bauer
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
